== Card-list wording: "a [Immune to Alter] Effect" (8 November 2026) ==
The release-sheet slip [[:File:VB2-137E-It_Is_The_Future_You_See.png]] prints “▼ Battle Plan, Do, Or Do Not, and an [Immune to Alter] Effect.” The game text here now follows the slip (“an”). The PC website card list ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] … [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11]) has “Deploy from Reserve Deck Battle Plan, Do, Or Do Not, and a [Immune to Alter] Effect.” Apart from the spelled-out ▼ (notation), the only difference is the article before the icon (“a” for “an”). Whether that is a version is waiting for Bill's ruling; until then no (Errata) page is made.
